Capability provider projections
Four independent levels; `enforceable` is claimed only where a real gating hook exists.

claude-code (supported, placement: sessionstart-hook)
  discoverable=supported  selectable=supported  invocable=supported  enforceable=supported
  Bootstrap on a SessionStart hook; host invokes skills/agents; real hooks gate behavior (enforceable).

claude-plugin (supported, placement: sessionstart-hook-via-plugin-build)
  discoverable=supported  selectable=supported  invocable=supported  enforceable=supported
  Same SessionStart hook, propagated into the plugin payload at plugin generation; plugin hooks gate behavior.

codex (partial, placement: instruction-file)
  discoverable=supported  selectable=supported  invocable=advisory  enforceable=unsupported
  Migration writes a bounded AGENTS bootstrap plus validated .codex/capabilities.json; skill/command projection is advisory and hook enforcement version-gated ⇒ not enforceable.

qwen (report-only, placement: none)
  discoverable=unknown  selectable=unknown  invocable=unknown  enforceable=unknown
  No tested projection — report-only; no capability behavior is claimed until a qwen adapter is authored.

Providers not listed are report-only — no capability behavior is claimed for them.
